name: email-EU
description: Nodes represent email addresses. Each hyperedge represents an email exchange involving the set of participating addresses (and may include a timestamp/weight when available).

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., email-EU).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., true).

edges_metadata.original_timestamp: (INT) Raw email timestamp from the source data, recorded at one-second resolution (e.g., 1064021027).
edges_metadata.time: (INT) Normalized email timestamp, equal to original_timestamp minus the first raw timestamp in the dataset (e.g., 0).
edges_metadata.weight: (INT) Number of email records collapsed into this sender/recipient set at the same timestamp (e.g., 1).
